recipes.title: Weeknight Tacos
recipes.description: Fast ground-beef tacos the whole table actually eats.
instructions: Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, 8 minutes.
Season with taco spice and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the shells in the oven for 3 minutes.
Set out fillings and let everyone build their own.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Pasta
recipes.description: Fifteen-minute pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Boil salted water; cook spaghetti al dente.
Sizzle garlic in olive oil; add tomatoes until they burst, 6 minutes.
Toss pasta with tomatoes and torn basil; finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Crispy thighs, potatoes and green beans on one tray.
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C.
Toss potatoes with oil; roast 15 minutes.
Add chicken and beans; roast 25 minutes until skin is crisp.
Squeeze lemon over everything.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Eggs, potato and cheese rolled and pan-crisped.
instructions: Diced potatoes in butter until golden, 10 minutes.
Scramble eggs soft; season well.
Fill tortillas, roll tight, crisp seam-down in the pan.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Lemony red-lentil soup; cheap, fast, freezer-friendly.
instructions: Soften onion and carrot in olive oil, 8 minutes.
Add lentils, cumin and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend half the pot for body; finish with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Pan Pizza
recipes.description: Cast-iron pan pizza, chewy middle, crispy edge.
instructions: Mix dough; rest 2 hours at room temp.
Press into oiled cast-iron pan; rest 20 minutes.
Top and bake at 250°C for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Crispy salmon over rice with quick cucumber.
instructions: Cook rice; season with vinegar.
Sear salmon skin-side down 6 minutes; flip 2 minutes.
Flake over rice with cucumber and sauces.

recipes.title: Greek Salad + Pita
recipes.description: No-cook summer dinner with warm pita.
instructions: Chop vegetables roughly; dress with oil and oregano.
Crumble feta on top; warm pita in a dry pan.
Serve pita alongside for scooping.

recipes.title: Beef Chili
recipes.description: Weeknight chili; the beans are not negotiable.
instructions: Brown beef and onion, 10 minutes.
Add chili powder, tomatoes, beans; simmer 35 minutes.
Serve with cheese (never olives).

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Stirred-with-love risotto; good for a slow evening.
instructions: Brown mushrooms in half the butter; set aside.
Toast rice; deglaze with wine.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, 20 minutes.
Fold in mushrooms, parmesan, remaining butter.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Noodles
instructions: Stir-fry hard vegetables 3 minutes over high heat.
Add noodles, soy, ginger, a splash of water; toss 3 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: Two-minute dessert for the kids' win column.
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients in the mug.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave 90 seconds; do not overcook.
